content:
EFF supporters are why our lawyers can  sue the government when it spies on you and chills your free speech. EFF members make it possible for our technologists to  build the tools  to protect privacy on the streets and online. And donations to EFF are what fuels our activists as they fight to pass good laws and to end bad company practices. 

But you can also support EFF by buying gear from the EFF Online Shop! And starting today, take 20% off your entire order with coupon code: " BL4CKFRID4Y "!  From now until midnight on Monday the 30th, stock up and stand out with rad, stylish EFF merch: 

Shop Now

Support Digital Rights with Every Purchase

What's New

The Digital Unicorn was created for EFF's 25th anniversary, and it was too good to leave in the archives. It's back on the Digital Unicorn Tank Top  to light the way to a brighter future: a soft black muscle tank in 100% combed and ring-spun cotton with a relaxed fit.

   

Crows are very intelligent (and can even be trained!). Our  Surveillance Is For the Birds Sticker  depicts a murder of crows disabling a surveillance camera.

EFF is fighting to end warrantless license plate reader mass surveillance—and we're going to win. But if they're going to take a picture, frame it for 'em with our  Anti License Plate Reader (ALPR) Frame. It says, in raised lettering: "I Do Not Consent to the Tracking of This Vehicle," and includes an EFF logo. 

Shop Now

Take 20% OFF with Code "BL4CKFRID4Y" 

What's Hot

This embossed, tactile sticker depicts the  fiery hair, sword, and scales of   Lady Justice, with braille characters  reading "justice" and "EFF." With this sticker you won't just show your support for a world where justice is available to everyone—you'll feel it.

You can also bring a little texture to your favorite gear with the Circuit Brain Stim Sticker, printed with four layers of embossing for a noticeably raised tactile surface. The textured finish is as distinctive to touch as it is to see.

And once your see our  Motherboard Hooded Sweatshirt  you'll know why it rounds out our list of the hottest items this year. It's got what our designers call "Lovelace-Klimtian" vibes. The same artwork is also available on the Scoop Neck Motherboard Shirt.

For Your Next Party

Our Liquid Core EFF Dice  are perfect for tabletop games. Seven red resin dice with a glittery core in a clear-view metal tin, with the EFF logo on the D20.  And they pair perfectly with the  HTTP Code Playing Cards,  designed by security expert, EFF board member, and competitive poker player Tarah Wheeler for the EFF benefit tournament at DEF CON. Every card carries an HTTP status code. 

                    

Stocking Stuffers Under $20

Laptop  Camera Cover Set: seven specially-designed stickers with a unique ultra-removable adhesive for reuse while preventing gummy residue—far better than masking tape! Perfect for a laptop, webcam, phone, tablet, and most other potential spying devices. 

"I Do Not Consent to the Search of This Device" sticker 3-pack  is an evergreen reminder of your right to privacy in the digital world. 

This poop-emoji sticker is the literal depiction of EFF Advisor Cory Doctor's concept of enshittification. It's also available as an   Enamel pin. 

Got a new laptop? Cover it in one go with the  Privacy Sticker Combo, 30th Anniversary Sticker Combo, and the Multisticker Sheet Pack.

Shop Now

Support Digital Rights with Every Purchase

Give Membership, Get a Thank-You Gift

If you'd rather not guess sizes, an EFF Membership Gift Certificate arrives by email and redeems for a year of membership. The recipient picks their own gift at redemption—they get what they want, and you get the credit!

And don't forget: Join EFF as a member to get a sticker sheet and a special  "Claw Back" tee (or an EFF35 Cityscape tee). 

Order Early

For delivery by December 25 in the continental U.S., order by December 10. Questions about sizes, shipping, or memberships? Please reach out to membership@eff.org. Thank you for supporting our mission and grabbing the perfect gifts for the digital rights defender in your life!
